findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_sales_report, search_customers · Private data: get_product_sales_detail, list_invoices, get_invoice, get_overdue_invoices, get_company_settings, create_invoice_draft · Public sink: search_customers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_sales_report, search_customers · Private data: get_product_sales_detail, list_invoices, get_invoice, get_overdue_invoices, get_company_settings, create_invoice_draft · Public sink: search_customers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_dashboard_stats" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
